areas.label: Register allocation
areas.evidence: Remaining ~140 diff lines are a register cascade: the hit counter (u16 count) gets r4 instead of r7 in the target-gather loops, so player is reloaded into r1 and &player->done takes slot 0xC0 instead of 0xD4 (temporaries shift +4). From the lreg dump, count priority (10 refs/432 insns) beats num (3 refs/93 insns); in the original num is allocated first. Permuter (30 min) found nothing.
